survivors.claim: HEAD commit 6a539b4 ('harness: match DevTools events by name') loosens waitFor's event match from `msg.method === method` to `msg.method.includes(method)` with no Decision, no test, no rationale in the commit body or the run ledger, and spends a size-baseline raise on it. Semantically a no-op for every reachable input today (single call site passes the literal 'Page.loadEventFired'; waitFor is not exposed to callers), so this is hygiene, not a defect — but it is an unowned edit riding this spec's range.
survivors.impact: A future caller waiting on a shorter event name would silently match the wrong event; nothing in the spec or tests explains why the exact match was dropped, so the next reader cannot tell intent from accident.
survivors.evidence: git show 6a539b4 -> only hunk in the harness: `- if (msg.method === method && ...` / `+ if (msg.method.includes(method) && ...`; commit body is the one subject line. grep of .claude/spec-runs.jsonl and specs/20260909/ for 'includes(method)' / 'by name when resolving' -> no hits. Spec Decisions D1-D9 name no event-matching change. node repro: for CDP names ['Page.loadEventFired','Page.frameNavigated',...,'Page.loadEventFiredX'] the only string where includes() differs from === is the synthetic 'Page.loadEventFiredX'; ''.includes matches everything. Reachability: grep -n waitFor tests/mocks/chrome-harness.js -> 2 hits (definition line 130, one call at 147 with the literal); line 167 `return await fn({ navigate, evalJs, setViewport, sleep, send, sessionId })` does not expose waitFor.

survivors.claim: D4 says withChrome routes every DevTools `send` through withDeadline, but the dialog auto-accept at line 143 deliberately calls rawSend, so that one send is unbounded (its rejection is already swallowed by .catch, so no hang results — only a pending Map entry that never settles if Chrome dies mid-dialog).
survivors.impact: One DevTools request has no deadline; in practice harmless because its outcome is ignored, but the contract text and the code disagree on the word 'every'.
survivors.evidence: Spec D4: "withChrome(chrome, fn, opts = {}) routes every DevTools send and navigate's Page.loadEventFired wait through it". Diff hunk: `- send('Page.handleJavaScriptDialog', ...).catch(() => {})` / `+ rawSend('Page.handleJavaScriptDialog', { accept: true, promptText: 'reviewer' }, sessionId).catch(() => {})`. D4 exempts only the launch wait and the Browser.close race, not the dialog ack.
